title: PTP value and Sony property-data decoders still read without a reply length
description:
Residual of audit 019/026 found by the fix review. ptp_sony_decode_property() walks GetAllDevicePropData by the received count without the buffer size; ptp_decode_property_value() (Fuji and Olympus value polls) decodes strings and numbers without a size; Canon AvailListChanged image-format entries are bounded by count, not by their variable size. Writes on these paths are now capacity-checked, so the remaining impact is reads past the reply (USB pads 1024 zeroed bytes, ICA does not). Source-only, not reproduced. Next: pass the reply end into these decoders and add fake truncated-reply cases.

Imported from .factory/findings/archive/FND-20261025093224-2d50-fix-ptp-findings-001.json (category: security, blocking: no).
